decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, timer 44:21.072, dots pale. Plain W drifted the car off the gravel's left edge; it sits on grass about one car width left of the road, nose up-frame, with pines and the lake to the left and the white house on the right. The road curves down-right and away.
decision.hypothesis: The road lies to the right of the nose, so a D beat should swing the car back onto the gravel; at 7 mph off-road a short steer has usually cost only a couple of mph.
decision.memory: Plain W on this left-curving stretch again drifted left onto grass within one second; the left verge here borders a pine stand and lake, so rejoin early rather than letting the gap grow.
